role: Declares the dig state machine: the ItemInWorldManager fields, the digging player, the spawned-entity record, a case's outputs and the dig environment, plus the drive ops (tick, cancel, finish) and the case begin/end calls.

structs.name: dig_mgr
structs.java: ItemInWorldManager's dig fields (isDestroyingBlock, initialDamage, partiallyDestroyedBlockX/Y/Z, curblockDamage, receivedFinishDiggingPacket, posX/Y/Z, initialBlockDamage, durabilityRemainingOnBlock) plus the clicked block for the client-prediction case

structs.name: dig_player
structs.java: the EntityPlayer state the dig reads: held ItemStack, enchant levels, onGround/inWater, haste and mining fatigue, FoodStats exhaustion, the entity Random, stats

structs.name: dig_ent
structs.java: one spawned EntityItem, EntityXPOrb or silverfish as the dig probe records it

structs.name: dig_env
structs.java: the world, Det role, world Random, BlockChest's static Random and the manager and player together

gpu: line 105, struct dig_env: holds pointers to the world and det_state
line 124-125, struct dig_env: partial is a function-pointer callback with an opaque context
notes: The Java field names in dig_mgr are mapped from the header comment and ItemInWorldManager's MCP names.
